title: What is sepsis? Answer in one sentence.

messages.content: What is sepsis? Answer in one sentence.

Sepsis is a life-threatening medical condition that occurs when an overwhelming immune response to an infection causes widespread inflammation and organ dysfunction, as defined by the Surviving Sepsis Campaign (SSC) guidelines (1).

Reference:
(1) Dellinger RP et al. Surviving Sepsis Campaign: International Guidelines for Management of Severe Sepsis and Septic Shock: 2016. Crit Care Med. 2017;45(2):e1145-e1173. doi: 10.1097/CCM.0000000000000254
